evidence.title: Schema change detected in upstream dataset
evidence.excerpt: At 2026-08-05T10:00:00Z, a schema change was detected in the customer_events table: column 'email' changed from STRING to INT64.

evidence.title: Error in downstream job
evidence.excerpt: Failed to parse field email: expected string, got integer at 2026-08-05T10:05:00Z

hypotheses.statement: The root cause is a schema regression in the upstream dataset where the 'email' column changed from STRING to INT64, causing downstream parsing failures.

action_plan.rationale: The root cause is a schema regression in the upstream dataset, causing downstream jobs to fail. Reverting the schema change and reprocessing will restore normal operations.
action_plan.expected_outcome: Downstream jobs will resume normal processing with correct data.

steps.action: Revert the schema change in the upstream dataset
